query: Grill me on this before I build it: I want to add a feature where users can export their dashboard data to CSV.
expected_behavior: Asks exactly one question at a time and waits, rather than dumping a list of questions
Attaches a recommended answer and a concrete reason to each question
Surfaces failure and edge cases (large exports, empty data, permissions on which rows a user may export)
Does not write code or scaffold the feature before shared understanding is confirmed
Ends by summarizing resolved decisions and asking the user to confirm before implementation
